simplemathjax-visualeditor-mwmathdialog-: Title of the VisualEditor dialog for inserting/editing a SimpleMathJax <math> formula, and label of the Insert-menu tool and context item that open it.
simplemathjax-visualeditor-mwchemdialog-: Title of the VisualEditor dialog for inserting/editing a SimpleMathJax <chem> chemical formula, and label of the Insert-menu tool and context item that open it.
simplemathjax-visualeditor-mwformuladial: Label of the TeX/chem input field in the VisualEditor formula dialog (shared by the <math> and <chem> dialogs).
Label of the display-mode picker (default/inline/block) in the VisualEditor formula dialog (shared by the <math> and <chem> dialogs).
